mapper.select: SELECT ua.id, ua.username, ua.password_hash, ua.display_name, ua.enabled, ua.token_version, ua.staff_id, s.department_id, s.active staff_active FROM user_account ua LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id=ua.staff_id WHERE ua.username = #{username}
SELECT r.code FROM role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.active = TRUE ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.active=TRUE ORDER BY p.code
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET last_login_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role(user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM role WHERE code = #{roleCode}
